description: Perform Bader charge analysis on bulk CaF2 (fluorite).
user_prompt: Perform Bader charge analysis on bulk CaF2 (fluorite structure, Fm-3m). Report the Bader net charge (in electrons) for Ca atoms and F atoms.

references: Stachowicz, Malinska, Parafiniuk & Wozniak, Acta Cryst. B 73, 643 (2017)
method.modeling: Conventional fluorite cell (Fm-3m); 4 Ca and 8 F atoms, with F at equivalent T_d sites.
method.rationale: Value from the experimental QTAIM/Bader charge density of CaF2 (Stachowicz et al. 2017: multipole refinement of single-crystal X-ray data, Ag radiation, 90 K). The key_parameters are the recommended VASP protocol for running this case (the reference value is experimental). Tolerance +/-0.20 e absolute reflects the experimental-QTAIM vs VASP-PBE grid-Bader methodology gap.
